name: Amy B. Beller
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Boca Raton, Florida
side_practice_areas: Estate Planning & Probate, Estate & Trust Litigation
about: Amy B. Beller is an attorney at Beller Smith, P.L., based in Boca Raton, Florida, where she focuses her practice on probate administration and estate planning. With a career centered on helping clients address important estate-related matters, she provides legal guidance designed to support individuals and families as they plan for the future and navigate the administration of estates.

Ms. Beller’s practice encompasses probate administration, assisting clients with the legal processes involved in settling estates and ensuring assets are properly administered. She also advises clients on estate planning, helping them establish plans that reflect their individual circumstances, priorities and long-term goals. Her work in these areas reflects a commitment to providing knowledgeable and practical counsel on matters that can have significant financial and personal implications.

Ms. Beller earned her Bachelor of Arts degree from Hofstra University in 1986. She continued her education at Hofstra University School of Law, where she earned her Juris Doctor with distinction in 1992. She was admitted to practice law in New York in 1993 and later expanded her practice to Florida, gaining admission to The Florida Bar in 1998.

Demonstrating her commitment to the legal profession, Ms. Beller is actively involved in several professional organizations. She serves as chair of the Probate Committee of the Palm Beach County Bar Association, where she contributes to the advancement of legal knowledge and professional dialogue concerning probate matters. She is also a member of the South Palm Beach County Bar Association.

In addition, Ms. Beller is a committee member of The Florida Bar’s Real Property, Probate and Trust Law Section. Her involvement in these organizations reflects her continued engagement with developments in probate, estate planning and related areas of law. Her professional accomplishments have been recognized with an AV Preeminent* peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell, one of the highest distinctions available for legal ability and professional ethics.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
